title: Perimeter & Area
description: Class 7 IMO — Perimeter & Area: area of parallelograms and triangles, circumference and area of a circle, unit conversion, and word problems on paths and rings.

topics.title: Area of Parallelogram & Triangle
topics.concept: The area of a parallelogram is base × height. The area of a triangle is ½ × base × height. The height is always measured at right angles to the base.

examples.problem: Find the area of a parallelogram with base 8 cm and height 5 cm.
Find the area of a triangle with base 10 cm and height 6 cm.

quiz.q: What is the area of a triangle with base 12 cm and height 5 cm?
What is the area of a parallelogram with base 7 cm and height 4 cm?

topics.title: Circumference & Area of a Circle
topics.concept:
A circle is the set of all points equidistant from a fixed center point.

TermDefinitionFormula
Radius (r)Distance from center to edger = d / 2
Diameter (d)Distance across circle through centerd = 2r
ChordLine segment joining any two points on circle—
Circumference (C)Distance around the circleC = 2πr = πd
Area (A)Space enclosed by the circleA = πr²

Value of pi: π ≈ 3.14159... or 22/7 (approx). Use 22/7 when radius is a multiple of 7.

Semicircle: Area = πr²/2, Perimeter = πr + 2r

Quarter circle: Area = πr²/4, Perimeter = πr/2 + 2r

CIRCLE PARTS DIAGRAM:

              P
             /|
            / |r (radius)
           /  |
Q---------O---------R
   (diameter = 2r)

  O = center
  OP = radius (r)
  QR = diameter (d = 2r)
  PS = chord (does not pass through center)

FORMULAS:
  Circumference = 2 * pi * r  (or pi * d)
  Area          = pi * r^2
  Semicircle area = pi*r^2 / 2
  Quarter circle area = pi*r^2 / 4

examples.problem: Find the circumference of a circle of radius 7 cm (π = 22/7).
Find the area of a circle of radius 7 cm (π = 22/7).
Circle radius = 7cm. Find diameter, circumference, area. (use pi = 22/7)
Circle circumference = 62.8cm. Find radius and area. (pi = 3.14)
Semicircle radius = 14cm. Find perimeter and area. (pi = 22/7)
examples.solution: Perimeter = pi x r + 2r = 44 + 28 = 72cm. Area = pi x r^2 / 2 = 616/2 = 308cm^2.

recap: Area of a circle = πr²; use π ≈ 22/7.
radius (r) = half of diameter: r = d/2
Use pi = 22/7 when radius is a multiple of 7; otherwise use 3.14

quiz.q: A circle has radius 7 cm. What is its area (π = 22/7)?
A circle has diameter 7 cm. What is its circumference (π = 22/7)?

topics.title: Unit Conversion & Word Problems
topics.concept: Areas convert in squares: 1 m² = 10000 cm² (because 1 m = 100 cm and 100 × 100 = 10000). Word problems may involve a path or ring — find the larger area and subtract the smaller one.
recap: For a path or ring, subtract the inner area from the outer area.

questions.q: Area of a triangle = ½ × base × ___ ?
questions.explanation: Area of a triangle = ½ × base × height.
